Scope: Roslyn selected-active Preview/Regular/Parse, empty symbols; the same 364 pinned corpus files
Metric: Binder.BindExpression visits; includes opaque expressions and generated references, not faithful native source expressions
Method: Count-only instrumentation immediately after ExpressionsBound++; count expression runtime type and ReferenceNode.Name; no new AST nodes
GeneratedReferenceDefinition: ReferenceNode name starts with underscore and is absent from every source IdentifierToken.ValueText in that file
SourceMappingDefinition: Input CRLF is normalized to LF, then the production Roslyn active-branch stripper selects source. ExpressionSyntax identity is UTF-16 start/end in SELECTED source and Roslyn syntax kind. Original and selected source hashes are separately pinned by binder-source-coverage.json. native-exact means an exact non-raw Calor ExpressionNode span outside opaque boundaries, NOT semantic fidelity; unmapped is not necessarily omitted (e.g. callee strings/type names)
